mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_ID , N.NOTICE_TITLE , N.MEMBER_ID , N.COUNT , N.CREATED_DATE FROM NOTICE N JOIN MEMBER M ON (N.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) WHERE N.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY N.NOTICE_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE( NOTICE_ID, NOTICE_TITLE, CONTENT, MEMBER_ID ) VALUES( (SELECT NVL(MAX(NOTICE_ID), 0) + 1 FROM NOTICE), #{noticeTitle}, #{content}, #{memberId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND STATUS = 'Y'
